title: Verticals grid · photo-card catalog
description: Signature industry catalog. 20 CMS-addressable slots in a responsive photo-card grid. Each visible card has a media placeholder/photo slot, title, description, URL href, editable status label, editable CTA label, and status treatment. Lorem Ipsum ships live; the other default verticals ship coming soon with a waitlist CTA. Seven spare slots are hidden until an admin fills the title.

source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-25 — verticals grid uses Lorem ipsum photo-card catalog pattern, not small SVG glyph cards

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width industries grid background; separate from per-card media slots.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

notes: Empty-title slots are hidden via [hidden] + block.js (covers the case where the slot ships with the {{handlebar}} unfilled).
Media slots are real optional image slots. When a slot image URL is empty, the neutral striped placeholder with dimension + photo hint remains visible.
Grid renders 4 columns on wide desktop, 3 columns below 1180px, 2 below 880px, and 1 below 560px.
The 'live' state changes border treatment, photo meta accent, arrow, and Live badge. Apply by adding class 'is-live' to the slot card.
Coming-soon waitlist CTAs are editable label/link placeholders only; this block intentionally does not include a CMS uploader or waitlist modal.

Hover glow + halo are intentionally NOT delegated to effect.hover-rise: vertical-card's hover composes a depth shadow with the halo, and the .is-live ::after border ring would collide with effect.hover-rise's ::after. The local copy stays byte-identical to the effect's canonical values; if effect.hover-rise's geometry changes, update this block too.
